steps.title: Prepare qRT-PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Use the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (Life Technologies Catalog #11732088) to set up the Ross River Virus E2 TaqMan Assay.

steps.title: Run Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Perform the PCR cycling according to the following conditions:

substeps.instruction: Cycle 40 times: 95°C for 3 seconds, 60°C for 30 seconds, followed by a fluorescence acquisition step

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the following criteria for a satisfactory positive result:

substeps.instruction: Confirm the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase)
Verify a suitable level of fluorescence intensity compared to a positive control
Ensure the fluorescent curve clearly exceeds a defined threshold (CT) value early in the log-linear phase
Classify results as negative if the CT value is beyond 40 cycles
Confirm that No Template Controls (NTCs) do not produce a curve
